name: Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)
safety_phrases: H314: Causes severe skin burns and eye damage
storage: Dedicated acid cabinet, separate from bases and oxidizers.
neutralization: Neutralize spills with sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) before cleanup.

name: Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH)
safety_phrases: H314: Causes severe skin burns and permanent eye damage
storage: Dedicated base cabinet, separate from acids and aluminum.
neutralization: Neutralize dilute spills with weak acetic acid or citric acid.

name: Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4)
storage: Heavy acid cabinet, never store near organic chemicals.
neutralization: Dilute slowly into large excess of cold water and sodium bicarbonate.

name: Nitric Acid (HNO3)
storage: Dedicated oxidizer shelf. Keep isolated from all organic solvents.

name: Ammonia Solution (NH4OH / NH3)
storage: Well-ventilated cool base cabinet, away from hypochlorite bleach and acids.
neutralization: Dilute with water and neutralize with dilute acid.
